title: 7-Day Amanpuri Phuket Ultimate Golf & Peace Sanctuary
description: Iconic ultra-luxury at Amanpuri on Pansea Beach. Play Red Mountain, Blue Canyon (Canyon Course), and Aquella with bespoke holistic care.

signatureTour.title: Thailand Royal Siam
signatureTour.highlight: Upgrade to our ultimate royal tour pairing Amanpuri with Bangkok’s finest suites and private helicopter transfers.

inclusions.detail: Chauffeured private luxury vehicles for all airport, resort, and golf course journeys.
3 rounds: Red Mountain, Blue Canyon (Canyon Course), and Aquella.
6 nights in an Ocean Pavilion at Amanpuri on secluded Pansea Beach.
Signature holistic wellness bodywork and hydrotherapy relaxation.
Guaranteed morning tee sheets, private caddies, and dedicated equipment staging.

itinerary.title: Arrival on Pansea Beach & Aman Pavilion Check-In
itinerary.subtitle: Aman Sanctuary Welcome
itinerary.imageAlt: Amanpuri Phuket luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Arrive in Phuket where your private luxury transfer whisks you to Amanpuri, the legendary flagship of the Aman brand nestled in a secluded coconut grove on Pansea Beach. Settle into your Ocean Pavilion featuring classic Ayutthaya-inspired Thai architecture and an expansive outdoor sala.

Unwind with a welcome herbal infusion overlooking the turquoise Andaman Sea before dining at Nama, Amanpuri’s signature Japanese washoku restaurant.

itinerary.title: Tin-Mine Quarry Drama at Red Mountain Golf Club
itinerary.subtitle: Round 1: Red Mountain Quarry Test
itinerary.imageCaption: Red Mountain Golf Club — Johnathan Morrow / Al Tikkanen (Par 72, 7,002 Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Red Mountain Golf Club championship golf course Johnathan Morrow / Al Tikkanen Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Tackle Red Mountain Golf Club, Asia's most dramatic championship track. Sculpted through a historic tin mine with towering red cliffs and sheer vertical drops, this par-72 layout requires tactical driving and pinpoint club selection.

Return to Amanpuri for an afternoon relaxation session by the iconic midnight-black tiled swimming pool, followed by cocktails at the Sunset Bar.

itinerary.title: Championship Heritage at Blue Canyon (Canyon Course)
itinerary.subtitle: Round 2: Tiger Woods Johnnie Walker Layout
itinerary.imageCaption: Blue Canyon Country Club — Yoshikazu Kato (Par 72 (Canyon), 7,165 Yards (Canyon))
itinerary.imageAlt: Blue Canyon Country Club championship golf course Yoshikazu Kato Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Play the world-famous Canyon Course at Blue Canyon Country Club. Walk the exact fairways where Tiger Woods staged his historic 1998 comeback, taking on the legendary par-4 13th canyon carry hole.

After your round, enjoy lunch in the clubhouse before an executive transfer returns you to Amanpuri for a 90-minute signature Aman Spa holistic massage.

itinerary.title: Pansea Beach Seclusion & Aman Spa Restoration
itinerary.subtitle: Aman Day of Rest
itinerary.imageAlt: Amanpuri Phuket luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
A day of complete tranquility on Amanpuri's private crescent beach. Enjoy unhurried breakfast on your sala, snorkel over the coral reef in Pansea Bay, or participate in private yoga in the open-air pavilion. An optional private Aman yacht charter is available on request.

In the evening, savor authentic southern Thai cuisine at The Terrace, dining under the stars above the Andaman surf.

itinerary.title: Andaman Coastal Links at Aquella Golf Resort
itinerary.subtitle: Round 3: Coastal Links Finale
itinerary.imageCaption: Aquella Golf Resort & Country Club — Pacific Coast Design (Par 72, 7,000+ Yards)
itinerary.imageAlt: Aquella Golf Resort & Country Club championship golf course Pacific Coast Design Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Tee off at Aquella Golf & Country Club along the Andaman coast of Phang Nga. With firm turf, beachside holes, and cooling ocean breezes, this modern links layout provides an exhilarating finale to your Phuket golf experience.

Celebrate with drinks at Aquella’s clubhouse before returning to Amanpuri for an exclusive private beachfront dinner beside the waves.

itinerary.title: Pansea Bay Relaxation & Sunset Wine Tasting
itinerary.subtitle: Bespoke Island Leisure
itinerary.imageAlt: Amanpuri Phuket luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Enjoy an unhurried morning with breakfast served in your pavilion sala. Spend the day lounging on Pansea Beach or taking an optional sailing cruise into the sunset.

Gather for a private sommelier-led wine tasting and farewell dinner at Amanpuri's Mediterranean restaurant.

itinerary.title: VIP Departure via Phuket International Airport
itinerary.subtitle: Departure
itinerary.imageAlt: Amanpuri Phuket luxury accommodation Asia Golf Specialists
itinerary.description:
Take a final swim in the Andaman Sea before checking out with the assistance of your personal Aman host and AGS concierge.

Your private luxury transfer delivers your party to Phuket International Airport for your onward flight.

faqs.question: Is Pansea Beach entirely private?
faqs.answer: Yes, Pansea Beach is accessible exclusively by guests of Amanpuri and its neighboring property, ensuring complete seclusion.
